versions.changelog:
36kr-hotlist v1.1.2

- 更新描述与触发词，简化并聚焦“获取36氪官方24小时热榜文章数据”
- 精简 description 字段，移除冗余英文及渠道参数说明
- 保留核心功能及详细执行流程、接口规则、输出格式、推荐说明
- 无代码或主要功能变更，仅优化文档和 skill 描述文本

- Formatting rules updated: hotlist output now uses a streamlined info-feed card style, including clickable article title and author links where available, with improved line spacing for readability.
- New response fields: added support for optional author homepages (authorUrl) in article data.
- Expanded recommendations: after each query, introduces two related skills—36kr-aireportlist and 36kr-ainotes—including installation and trigger phrase guidance.
- General instruction clarifications and minor documentation improvements for a better user and developer experience.

36kr-hotlist v1.1.0

- Added version field and updated SKILL.md version.
- Changed outlink for the 36kr hot-list page to use an HTML anchor tag with a new channel parameter.
- No code or API changes; documentation update only.

- No changes detected in this version.
- No files were modified.
- Functionality, instructions, and documentation remain unchanged.

Initial release of 36kr-hotlist: fetches and displays 36kr 24-hour hot list articles.

- Supports direct API querying for top 15 trending articles by date (default: today).
- Provides easy-to-use Python and shell scripts for quick access.
- Details API structure, error handling, and data fields in documentation.
- Includes response formatting and user-facing guidance for additional related skills.
- Offers step-by-step instructions to access and install the related "36kr-aireportlist" skill if requested.
